chunks: O My servants who believe, surely My earth is vast, so worship only Me.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Inni ardi wasi'ah' in Surah Al-Ankabut?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a divine promise of relief for those who migrate for God's sake, linking physical migration (Hijrah) with spiritual elevation. It underscores the concept of 'Wasi'at al-Ard' (the expansiveness of the Earth), suggesting that believers are never trapped in oppression, as God provides ample space for worship and freedom. This assurance serves as a source of hope and resilience for the faithful during times of trial.
